celebration.name_latin: Dominica II Paschae seu Misericordiae Dei

summary_en: For the dioceses of Poland, the title of the Second Sunday of Easter receives the added denomination «seu Misericordiae Dei» (Divine Mercy Sunday); the liturgical texts remain those of the Missale Romanum and Liturgia Horarum for that day (decree of the Congregation by mandate of John Paul II; the covering letter to Card. Glemp is dated 24 January 1995).
excerpt: Summus Pontifex Ioannes Paulus II benigne indulget ut in dioecesibus Poloniae posthac titulo «Dominicae II Paschae» addatur haec denominatio «seu Misericordiae Dei», praescribens etiam ut ad celebrationem liturgicam eiusdem Dominicae, quod attinet, adhibendi semper sint textus qui in Missali Romano et in Liturgia Horarum pro illa die inveniuntur.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: For Brazil, Our Lady of Mount Carmel on 16 July is celebrated with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Brasile: 16 iulii, Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, festum (3 ian. 1995, Prot. 1457/94/L).

summary_en: For Mexico, a votive Mass of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Virgen de los Dolores» may be celebrated on the Friday of the fifth week of Lent; a votive Mass fixed to a liturgical day, not a calendar entry.
excerpt: Messico: conceditur ut in feria sexta Hebdomadae V Quadragesimae, Missa votiva in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo v.d. «Virgen de los Dolores» celebrari possit (18 mar. 1995, Prot. 452/95/L).

summary_en: For New Zealand, Blessed Mary Helen MacKillop, foundress, on 9 August as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Nuova Zelanda: 9 augusti, Beatae Mariae Helenae MacKillop, fundatricis, memoria ad libitum (24 ian. 1995, Prot. 5/95/L).

summary_en: For Poland, three celebrations are inserted in the proper calendar: Blessed Stanislaus Kazimierczyk, priest, on 5 May (optional memorial); Blessed Faustina Kowalska, virgin, on 5 October (optional memorial); Blessed Mary Angela Truszkowska, virgin, on 10 October (optional memorial).
The proper calendar of Puerto Rico is approved.
excerpt: Porto Rico: Calendarium proprium (28 ian. 1995, Prot. 1642/93/L).

summary_en: For Puerto Rico, under the same protocol as the calendar approval, a votive Mass of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Virgen de los Dolores» may be celebrated on the Friday of the fifth week of Lent; a votive Mass fixed to a liturgical day.
excerpt: Porto Rico: [...] Conceditur ut in feria sexta Hebdomadae V Quadragesimae Missa votiva in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo v.d. «Virgen de los Dolores» celebrari possit (28 ian. 1995, Prot. 1642/93/L).

summary_en: For Uruguay, the memorial of St Turibius of Mogrovejo, bishop, may be transferred in the proper calendar from 23 March to 27 April.
excerpt: Uruguay: conceditur ut in Calendario proprio memoria Sancti Toribii de Mogrovejo, episcopi, a die 23 martii ad diem 27 aprilis transferri valeat (15 mar. 1995, Prot. 2378/94/L).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Catania (Italy), Blessed Maddalena Caterina Morano, virgin, on 15 November as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Catania, Italia: 15 novembris, Beatae Magdalenae Catharinae Morano, virginis, memoria ad libitum (22 apr. 1995, Prot. 736/95/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beati Didacus Ventaja Milán et Emmanuel Medina Olmos, episcopi et martyres

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Granada (Spain), Blessed Diego Ventaja Milán and Manuel Medina Olmos, bishops and martyrs, on 30 August as a memorial.
excerpt: Granada, Spagna: 30 augusti, Beatorum Didaci Ventaja Milán et Emmanuelis Medina Olmos, episcoporum et martyrum, memoria (3 apr. 1995, Prot. 97/95/L).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Genoa (Italy), two celebrations are inserted in the proper calendar: Blessed Gianna Beretta Molla, mother of a family, on 28 April (optional memorial) and Blessed Maria Francesca Rubatto, virgin, on 9 August (optional memorial).
For the diocese of Münster (Germany), Blessed Titus Brandsma, martyr, on 27 July as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Münster, Germania: 27 iulii, Beati Titi Brandsma, martyris, memoria ad libitum (2 feb. 1995, Prot. 2385/94/L).

summary_en: For the diocese of Prato (Italy), the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary on 8 September is a solemnity in the cathedral church of the diocese (the grant is limited to the cathedral, not the whole diocese).
excerpt: Prato, Italia: 8 septembris, «In Nativitate B. Mariae Virginis», sollemnitas in ecclesia cathedrali dioecesis (14 ian. 1995, Prot. 1619/94/L).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Reims (France), Blessed Nicolas Roland, priest, on 27 April as an optional memorial in the whole archdiocese and as an obligatory memorial in the church where his body is kept.
excerpt: Reims, Francia: 27 aprilis, Beati Nicolai Roland, presbyteri, memoria ad libitum in universa archidioecesi, memoria vero obligatoria in ecclesia ubi corpus Beati asservatur (28 dec. 1994, Prot. 2269/94/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Agnes a Iesu de Langeac, monialis

summary_en: For the diocese of Saint-Flour (France), Blessed Agnes of Jesus de Langeac, nun, on 19 October as an optional memorial; the same decree is listed again under Decreta varia (p. 314) as the concession of her liturgical celebrations.
excerpt: Saint-Flour, Francia: 19 octobris, Beatae Agnetis a Iesu de Langeac, monialis, memoria ad libitum (25 ian. 1995, Prot. 2277/94/L).

target.institute: Benedettine del Santissimo Sacramento, Monastero della SS.ma Trinità in Francia

summary_en: For the Benedictine Nuns of the Blessed Sacrament, monastery of the Most Holy Trinity in France, the celebration of the Transitus of St Benedict may be transferred in the monastery church from 21 March to the following day (22 March); a single monastery.
excerpt: Benedettine del Santissimo Sacramento, Monastero della SS.ma Trinità in Francia: conceditur ut celebratio Transitus Sancti Benedicti in ecclesia eiusdem Monasterii a die 21 martii ad diem sequentem eiusdem mensis transferri valeat (7 feb. 1995, Prot. 2116/94/L).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Infante, virgo

summary_en: For the Discalced Carmelite nuns of the monastery of Danvers (U.S.A.), St Thérèse of the Child Jesus, virgin, on 1 October is a solemnity; a single monastery.
excerpt: Carmelitane Scalze, Monastero di Danvers (U.S.A.): 1 octobris, Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Infante, virginis, sollemnitas (20 mar. 1995, Prot. 383/95/L).

summary_en: For the Dominicans, five celebrations are inserted in the proper calendar: Blessed Hyacinthe-Marie Cormier, priest, 21 May; Blessed Ingrid of Skänninge, 2 September; Blessed Marie Poussepin, 14 October; Blessed Agnes of Jesus Galand, virgin, 19 October; Blessed Terence Albert O'Brien, bishop, and Peter Higgins, priest, martyrs, 30 October — all optional memorials. The protocol is printed «13291330/94/L», apparently a misprint for 1329-1330/94/L (the text approvals for Cormier and Galand on pp. 304 and 307 carry Prot. 1329/94/L and 1330/94/L).

target.institute: Oblati di San Giuseppe di Asta Pompeia

summary_en: For the Oblates of St Joseph of Asti, the celebration of St John Berchmans may be transferred from 14 August to 26 November.
excerpt: Oblati di San Giuseppe di Asta Pompeia: conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Ioannis Berchmans a die 14 augusti ad diem 26 novembris transferri valeat (8 apr. 1995, Prot. 671/95/L).

summary_en: For the Ursulines of St Jerome, St Jerome Emiliani, priest, on 8 February is a solemnity.
excerpt: Orsoline di S. Girolamo: 8 februarii, Sancti Hieronimi Emiliani, presbyteri, sollemnitas (3 mar. 1995, Prot. 160/95/L).

excerpt: Redentoristi, Provincia di Praga: Calendarium proprium (19 apr. 1995, Prot. 100/95/L).

excerpt: Suore della Sacra Famiglia del Sacro Cuore: Calendarium proprium (20 mar. 1995, Prot. 1262/94/L).

summary_en: For the Trinitarians, Blessed Elisabetta Canori Mora, mother of a family, on 4 February as a memorial.
excerpt: Trinitari: 4 februarii, Beatae Elisabeth Canori Mora, matris familias, memoria (30 ian. 1995, Prot. 2373/94/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Auxilium Christianorum»

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Help of Christians is confirmed as patroness of the Prelature of Mixes (Mexico).
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Auxilium Christianorum»: Patrona Praelaturae Mixepolitanae, Messico (14 ian. 1995, Prot. CD 287/91).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Nossa Senhora da Glória»

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Nossa Senhora da Glória is confirmed as patroness of the archdiocese and of the city of Maringá (Brazil); two dates are printed («14 et 25 ian. 1995»), the first is recorded here.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Nossa Senhora da Glória»: Patrona Archidioecesis et civitatis Maringaënsis, Brasile (14 et 25 ian. 1995, Prot. 2033/94/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Immaculatae Conceptionis»

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception is confirmed as patroness of the diocese of Málaga-Soatá (Colombia).
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Immaculatae Conceptionis»: Patrona Dioecesis Malagensis-Soatensis, Colombia (28 ian. 1995, Prot. 2371/94/L).

summary_en: St Agatha, virgin and martyr, is confirmed as principal patroness and St Francis of Paola, hermit, as secondary patron of the municipality of Sant'Agata di Esaro (diocese of San Marco Argentano, Italy); a single municipality, two celebrations.
excerpt: Sancta Agatha, virgo et martyr: Patrona principalis et Sanctus Franciscus de Paula, eremita: Patronus secundarius municipii v.d. «Sant'Agata di Esaro», San Marco Argentano, Italia (3 feb. 1995, Prot. 157/95/L).

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Madonna del Carmine is confirmed as principal patroness and St Augustine, bishop, as secondary patron of the town of Riccia (archdiocese of Campobasso, Italy); a single town, two celebrations.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Madonna del Carmine»: Patrona principalis et Sanctus Augustinus, episcopus: Patronus secundarius civitatis v.d. Riccia, Campobasso, Italia (17 feb. 1995, Prot. 278/95/L).

summary_en: Blessed Rafael Arnáiz Barón is confirmed as patron of the members of the cultural foundation «Rutas del Románico» (Santiago de Compostela, Spain); the patron of an association.
excerpt: Beatus Raphael Arnaiz Baron: Patronus sodalium Operis Fundati Culturalis v.d. «Rutas del Románico», Compostela, Spagna (22 feb. 1995, Prot. 1211/94/L).

summary_en: St Ansgar, bishop, is confirmed as patron of the archdiocese of Hamburg (Germany).
excerpt: Sanctus Ansgarius, episcopus: Patronus Archidioecesis Hamburgensis, Germania (1 mar. 1995, Prot. 105/95/L).

excerpt: Jalapa, Messico: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem novi Beati Raphaelis Guizar y Valencia, episcopi (16 ian. 1995, Prot. 2272/94/L).

excerpt: Barmherzige Schwestern vom hl. Kreuz: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem novae Beatae Mariae Theresiae Scherer (19 apr. 1995, Prot. 558/95/L).

excerpt: Dienerinnen des Heiligen Geistes von der Ewigen Anbetung: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem novae Beatae Helenae Stollenwerk (25 apr. 1995, Prot. 652/95/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Dominica Brun Barbantini, fundatrix

summary_en: For the Sisters Ministers of the Sick of St Camillus, the liturgical celebrations of the new Blessed Maria Domenica Brun Barbantini, foundress, are granted (no date or grade printed).
excerpt: Suore Ministre degli Infermi di S. Camillo: liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem novae Beatae Mariae Dominicae Brun Barbantini, fundatricis (27 apr. 1995, Prot. 674/95/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beati Claudius Jouffret de Bonnefont, presbyter, et Socii, martyres

summary_en: For the diocese of Autun (France), Blessed Claude Jouffret de Bonnefont, priest, and companions, martyrs, on 18 August as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Autun, Francia: 18 augusti, Beati Claudii Jouffret de Bonnefont, presbyteri, et Sociorum, martyrum, memoria ad libitum (13 dec. 1995, Prot. 2328/95/L).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Goa and Damão (India), Blessed Joseph Vaz, priest, on 16 January as a memorial.
excerpt: Goa e Damão, India: 16 ianuarii, Beati Iosephi Vaz, presbyteri, memoria (15 dec. 1995, Prot. 2046/95/L).

summary_en: For the diocese of Nardò-Gallipoli (Italy), a yearly votive Mass of Our Lady of Sorrows on the Friday of the fifth week of Lent and votive Masses of local patron saints on fixed days in named parishes (St George 27 February at Matino; St Quintinus 1 May at Alliste; St John the Almsgiver, Saturday after the second Sunday of May, at Casarano; Madonna della Coltura, Saturday after the third Sunday of May, at Parabita; St Sebastian, Saturday after the fourth Sunday of May, at Racale, and Saturday after the first Sunday of July, at Galatone); fixed-day votive Masses, not calendar entries.
excerpt: Nardò-Gallipoli, Italia: conceditur ut quotannis feria sexta Hebdomadae V Quadragesimae celebrari possit Missa votiva in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis Perdolentis necnon in honorem Sanctorum Patronum aliquibus in locis dioecesis, videlicet: – 27 februarii, in honorem S. Georgii, martyris, in paroecia S. Georgii in loco v.d. «Matino»; – 1 maii, in honorem S. Quintini, martyris, in loco v.d. «Alliste»; [...] (19 dec. 1995, Prot. 2358/95/L).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Tacna y Moquegua (Peru) is approved.
excerpt: Tacna y Moquegua, Perù, Calendarium proprium (19 dec. 1995, Prot. 1214/95/L).

summary_en: For the diocese of Verona (Italy), St Proculus, bishop, on 9 December as an optional memorial (the Latin collect and Italian texts are approved under the same protocol on pp. 675-676).
excerpt: Verona, Italia: 9 decembris, Sancti Proculi, episcopi, memoria ad libitum (23 nov. 1995, Prot. CD 1561/92).

target.institute: Canonici Regolari della Congregazione di S. Vittore

excerpt: Canonici Regolari della Congregazione di S. Vittore: Calendarium Proprium (15 dec. 1995, Prot. 2361/95/L).

summary_en: For the Society of Jesus, two celebrations are inserted in the proper calendar: Blessed Alberto Hurtado Cruchaga, priest, on 18 August (optional memorial) and Blessed Dominic Collins, martyr, on 30 October (optional memorial).
